◆ This is a plan, not a special mode; I haven’t started implementation. Reply go
  to execute this plan, or tell me what to change.

  Goal

  Execute plans2/prompt8.md: root-cause remediation of the stack-poc
  implementation per plans2/POC-ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW.md (46 findings, 5×P0), so
  one real synthetic October-2026 payroll travels end-to-end through PostgreSQL
  authority → DBOS durable execution → immudb content-bound evidence →
  independent content-verifying audit. Satisfy the 14 completion conditions in
  prompt8 §11 or document exactly which fail.

  Success Criteria

  • The app role cannot fabricate a snapshot and drive it to validated (PG-1
    closed), while legitimate authorized capture succeeds.
  • The DB-backed month computes real payroll from persisted captured inputs via
    synth.ComputePay (RC-1 closed); DB-backed output digest equals the canonical
    digest from the same snapshot + calculator version.
  • Workflow identity separates business run / input digest / attempt; changed
    inputs conflict loudly, ERROR retries work without table surgery,
    forged-SUCCESS pre-registration cannot authorize payroll (DB-3/DB-4/DB-5
    closed).
  • The auditor reconstructs evidence from PostgreSQL and verifies content
    against immudb with pinned genesis and read-only identities (IM-1/IM-7
    closed); PG tampering fails verification loudly.
  • plans2/POC-REMEDIATION-REPORT.md written; the three existing reports updated
    with old claims explicitly superseded, history preserved; RC-3/RC-8 report
    defects corrected.
  • Frozen migrations untouched, no 00013, PG16 volume preserved,
    synthetic-only, OT-001 BLOCKED, nothing committed.

  Approach

  Follow prompt8 §9 phase order (A→F). Fix root-cause chains only, in dependency
  order: PG authority first (everything else trusts it), then DBOS execution,
  then ledger evidence. Do not chase P2/P3 nits unless they sit on a touched
  path (exceptions: RC-8 count fix and RC-3 §6 repair, both cheap and Gate
  C-facing).

  Key decision 1 — PG-1 fix vehicle: POC SQL overlay + production-migration
  proposal doc. Verified live: 00012:1094-1099 grants app INSERT on all snapshot
  tables and the migration's own verify block requires it (00012:1133-1135), so
  the real-schema fix (revoke + DEFINER capture) cannot land without changing
  frozen code. Implement the enforcement as a POC-scoped overlay (same pattern
  as gate/gate2_poc.sql, new gate/pg_authority.sql, applied to the disposable
  POC DB via a runbook step) that revokes direct app write on
  snapshot/claim/close/outbox/backlink tables and installs narrowly-scoped
  DEFINER operations deriving data from authoritative tables. Ship alongside it
  a production-migration proposal document describing the equivalent
  reviewed-migration change. Rejected alternative: parallel POC snapshot tables
  — would prove nothing about the real-schema boundary. This satisfies prompt8
  §1 ("translatable into a properly reviewed production migration") without
  violating frozen/00013 constraints.

  Key decision 2 — U4 scope: Tx-capable helpers local to dbosflow, not an a2
  service refactor. Capture bodies must run inside dbos.Tx (prompt8 §4.1 forbids
  a separate pool connection), but a2 services take *pgxpool.Pool. Write thin
  Tx-taking SQL helpers in the POC package for capture/persist/finalize paths;
  leave service signatures untouched. The full U4 refactor stays estimated/out
  of scope.

  Key decision 3 — identity model. Business-run UUID in a new app-owned
  poc_payroll_run table (unique per employer+period+revision, DB-enforced);
  input digest pinned at capture; each execution attempt gets a unique workflow
  ID linked to the run; WorkflowIDReusePolicyReject on attempts (verified to
  exist in v1.8.0, workflow.go:935-936) plus an explicit input-drift check (same
  run + changed digest → conflict error, new revision required). This closes
  DB-3/DB-4 without table surgery and keeps deterministic IDs only where safe.

  Key decision 4 — approval via DBOS Send/Recv. Recv[R](ctx, topic, timeout) +
  Send both verified present in v1.8.0 (workflow.go:3528,3670). New
  poc-run approve --run-id … --decision … subcommand sends the decision; the
  workflow verifies it against PG business authority (approver allow-list row +
  run state) before finalization; restart-during-wait is a crash test.

  Key decision 5 — auditor rebuild. Read-only PG role + read-only immudb user
  (verified CreateUser in SDK client.go:840); auditor reads finalized PG
  artifact, reconstructs canonical evidence, recomputes digests, fetches ledger
  entries via verified ops, compares field-by-field;
  --expect-state-hash/--expect-uuid enforcement flags replace default
  --accept-genesis; genesis committed to a file outside writer control via an
  executed operator step.

  Key decision 6 — outbox/backlink redesign. DEFINER poc_outbox_enqueue deriving
  payload from persisted artifacts (closes IM-13: month/capture become the real
  producer); transition guard table (closes PG-5/IM-12
  forge/suppress/mutate/squat); backlink PK → (pg_table, pg_id, event_uuid) with
  conflict→loud error (closes IM-11); VerifiedGet-based recovery (closes IM-9;
  verified VerifiedGet* in SDK); reconciler path distinguishing
  transient/confirmed/poisoned/reconciled states (closes IM-10/DB-11).

  Key decision 7 — report repair. RC-3: rewrite the truncated §6 from surviving
  session logs if present, else mark the evidence lost honestly and re-derive
  the re-derivable parts (E5 counts) by re-running. RC-8: correct synth 9/9
  everywhere. E5: restate units (packages vs tests) explicitly.

  Steps

  Phase A — Establish the truth (reproduce, no fixes). On the disposable stack
  (verified up: a2-poc-postgres, a2-poc-immudb healthy): (1) run the PG-1
  four-statement chain as app, observe validated; (2) mutate one PG snapshot row
  post-backlink, observe auditor still passing; (3) resubmit a corrected month
  under the same month ID, observe the stale result. Record outputs verbatim
  into the remediation report's "before" section.

  Phase B — Correct PostgreSQL authority. New
  poc/payroll-month/gate/pg_authority.sql (+ runbook apply step): revoke direct
  app INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on snapshot/claim/close/outbox/backlink tables;
  DEFINER poc_snapshot_capture (gate + population/pack/coverage verification +
  snapshot + claims + run row, all in-caller-txn); DEFINER poc_close_period
  rewrite (close timestamp from DB clock, duplicate handling, no squat);
  closed-period writer trigger rewritten against real columns (pay_period_id
  joins per table); poc_verify_claims redesigned around real source
  relationships, both directions + vacuous-empty rejection, EXECUTE withheld
  from app; DEFINER outbox enqueue + transition guard; backlink PK change. Port
  trigger gaps from the spec: DELETE coverage, sorted dual-key locking,
  payroll_run/period writers gated. Regression battery: full §3.2 exploit chain
  as app (all fail) + legitimate capture (succeeds); writer-first AND
  capture-first interleavings; close races. Write the production-migration
  proposal doc. Gate: new PG acceptance tests green (§6 list: 8 items).

  Phase C — Connect DBOS to actual payroll. Rewrite dbosflow/: Stage A readiness
  (employer/period/input-digest, typed rejects); Stage B capture in
  RunAsTransaction calling the DEFINER capture (gate inside txn, no side pool);
  Stage C calculation from the persisted snapshot via existing synth.ComputePay
  (no logic duplication); Stage D result persistence in RunAsTransaction
  (employee lines, components, pack digests, calc version, input/output digests,
  unique constraints); Stage E Recv approval wait + approve subcommand + PG
  authority check; Stage F DEFINER finalization
  (existence/digest/approval/blocker/eligibility checks, immutable originals,
  successor linkage); Stage G outbox enqueue in the finalization txn. Identity
  model per decision 3. Rewrite exactly-once assertions to count business
  artifacts/unique keys, never status rows. Crash battery: pre/post-commit
  kills, calc-step kill, restart-during-approval, dup-submit, forged-SUCCESS
  pre-registration under the real ID (must fail closed). Gate: 9 DBOS acceptance
  items green.

  Phase D — Connect real payroll to immudb. Real evidence Record from persisted
  artifacts (run/event UUIDs, input snapshot digest, pack + calc digests, output
  digest, approval/finalization refs, supersedes); worker recovery via
  VerifiedGet + full field re-verification; auditor rebuild per decision 5;
  distinct writer/auditor immudb users in compose + runbook; genesis ceremony
  executed and committed out-of-band; disposable host-corruption test per review
  §IM-8 (copy volume, flip bytes, swap-mount, expect proof failure, down -v
  after — never against a needed volume). Tamper battery: all 9 prompt8 §5.2
  cases. Gate: 10 immudb acceptance items green.

  Phase E — Full integration. One October-2026 month through the connected path:
  seed → capture → calculate → persist → approve → finalize → enqueue → anchor →
  independent verify. Inject the critical failures (kill at capture commit, kill
  at append/backlink boundary, restart during approval, duplicate delivery,
  correction-after-finalize). Independently recompute every digest from pinned
  inputs; assert DB-backed output == canonical digest. Distinguish
  finalized/blocked/exceptions/net/original/correction in the demo output.

  Phase F — Reassess + report. Re-run the review's three §2 questions against
  the connected path; re-grade the §11 guarantee table (PROVEN/PARTIAL/NOT
  PROVEN/CONTRADICTED); revise per-technology recommendations (no auto-retain).
  Write plans2/POC-REMEDIATION-REPORT.md (11 sections per prompt8 §10, honest
  taxonomy); update the three existing reports by supersession; correct
  RC-3/RC-8/E5-units. Final frozen/PG16/synthetic/no-commit verification.

  Validation Plan

  • Each phase ends with its acceptance battery green on the live disposable
    stack (go test ./e2e/ -run … per battery + named live probes), asserting
    persisted business state, never status rows or error strings alone; attack
    tests run as app/worker roles, never superuser.
  • Reproducibility: DB-backed month digest == poc-run canonical digest from the
    same snapshot; full POC suite (go test ./... in poc/payroll-month) green at
    the end; go vet + gofmt clean.
  • Highest-risk validation: Phase B DEFINER capture (a too-tight boundary
    breaks legitimate capture; a too-loose one re-admits fabrication) — the
    paired exploit-chain-must-fail + legitimate-capture-must-succeed tests are
    the gate that cannot be skipped or narrowed.

  Risks / Open Questions

  • poc_verify_claims redesign needs the real source-table relationship map
    (snapshot → terms/status/sheets/packs); if the frozen schema cannot express
    some membership edge, the verifier must reject loudly and the limitation is
    recorded, not papered over.
  • DBOS Recv timeout/restart semantics need a live spike before the approval
    test is finalized (APIs verified present; behavior under kill verified in
    Phase C, not assumed).
  • immudb user creation + read-only permission granularity need a live spike in
    Phase D (API verified present).
  • E5 session logs may not survive for the RC-3 §6 rewrite — fallback is an
    honest "evidence lost" marker plus re-runnable commands, never
    reconstruction from memory.
  • Scope guard: Exp2A baseline stays NOT BUILT and labeled; T1–T13 run only
    where they verify a corrected root cause; no P2/P3 drive-bys off the touched
    path.

  115 +-- ============================================================ Part 3 ==
  116 +-- Source-row hash projections (single definition used by BOTH the
  117 +-- capture writer and the verifier, so they cannot drift apart).
  118 +-- Each projection binds the columns the capture decision depends on.
  119 +CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poc_src_hash(p_table text, p_row uuid)
  120 +RETURNS bytea LANGUAGE plpgsql
  121 +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  122 +DECLARE
  123 +    v_text text;
  124 +BEGIN
  125 +    CASE p_table
  126 +    WHEN 'employee' THEN
  127 +        SELECT m.id::text || '|' || m.employee_no
  128 +          INTO v_text FROM public.employee m WHERE m.id = p_row;
  129 +    WHEN 'employment_terms' THEN
  130 +        SELECT t.id::text || '|' || t.effective_from::text || '|' ||
  131 +               COALESCE(t.effective_to::text, '') || '|' || t.monthly_bas
       ic::text
  132 +          INTO v_text FROM public.employment_terms t WHERE t.id = p_row;
  133 +    WHEN 'timesheet' THEN
  134 +        SELECT s.id::text || '|' || s.status || '|' || COALESCE(s.approve
       d_at::text, '')
  135 +          INTO v_text FROM public.timesheet s WHERE s.id = p_row;
  136 +    WHEN 'attendance_interval' THEN
  137 +        SELECT i.id::text || '|' || i.local_date::text || '|' ||
  138 +               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.interval_end - i.interval_start))::b
       igint::text ||
  139 +               '|' || i.kind
  140 +          INTO v_text FROM public.attendance_interval i WHERE i.id = p_ro
       w;
  141 +    WHEN 'leave_request' THEN
  142 +        SELECT l.id::text || '|' || l.from_date::text || '|' || l.to_date
       ::text ||
  143 +               '|' || l.status || '|' || l.days::text
  144 +          INTO v_text FROM public.leave_request l WHERE l.id = p_row;
  145 +    WHEN 'compensation_line' THEN
  146 +        SELECT c.id::text || '|' || c.kind || '|' || c.code || '|' ||
  147 +               c.amount_monthly::text || '|' || c.effective_from::text ||
  148 +               '|' || COALESCE(c.effective_to::text, '')
  149 +          INTO v_text FROM public.compensation_line c WHERE c.id = p_row;
  150 +    WHEN 'poc_rule_pack_schedule' THEN
  151 +        -- Schedule rows are keyed by name, not uuid: p_row carries the
  152 +        -- digest's first 16 bytes reinterpreted is WRONG; instead the
  153 +        -- capture passes the row's (xmin-less) identity via a lookup.
  154 +        -- Simpler honest rule: pack pins are claimed by version text
  155 +        -- hashed with the row content (see poc_pack_claim_hash).
  156 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_src_hash: use poc_pack_claim_hash for pack r
       ows';
  157 +    ELSE
  158 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_src_hash: unknown table %', p_table;
  159 +    END CASE;
  160 +    IF v_text IS NULL THEN
  161 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_src_hash: row % missing in %', p_row, p_tabl
       e;
  162 +    END IF;
  163 +    RETURN public.digest(v_text, 'sha256');
  164 +END;

  189 +-- ============================================================ Part 4 ==
  190 +-- Claims + coverage verifier, redesigned (replaces the BROKEN
  191 +-- poc_verify_claims from gate2_poc.sql, which referenced nonexistent
  192 +-- columns and failed 42703 on every call).
  193 +--
  194 +-- Runs INSIDE the capture/validate transaction (caller holds the
  195 +-- employer gate). Checks BOTH directions over REAL source-table
  196 +-- relationships; raises (P0001) on the first defect class with counts.
  197 +-- A zero-row claim set NEVER validates (vacuous-empty rejection).
  198 +CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poc_verify_claims(p_run uuid, p_snapshot uuid)
  199 +RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql
  200 +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  201 +DECLARE
  202 +    v_employer uuid; v_period uuid; v_start date; v_end date;
  203 +    v_members int; v_claims int; v_missing int; v_stale int;
  204 +    v_orphan int; v_badrel int; v_baddec int; v_uncovered int;
  205 +    r record;
  206 +BEGIN
  207 +    SELECT s.employer_id, s.pay_period_id INTO v_employer, v_period
  208 +      FROM public.payroll_snapshot s WHERE s.id = p_snapshot AND s.payrol
       l_run_id = p_run;
  209 +    IF NOT FOUND THEN
  210 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: snapshot % not bound to run %
       ', p_snapshot, p_run
  211 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  212 +    END IF;
  213 +    SELECT p.starts_on, p.ends_on INTO v_start, v_end
  214 +      FROM public.pay_period p WHERE p.id = v_period;
  215 +
  216 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_members FROM public.payroll_snapshot_employee
       WHERE snapshot_id = p_snapshot;
  217 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_claims FROM public.poc_claim WHERE run_id = p_
       run;
  218 +    IF v_members = 0 OR v_claims = 0 THEN
  219 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: vacuous evidence (members=%,
       claims=%)', v_members, v_claims
  220 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  221 +    END IF;
  222 +
  223 +    -- (a) Every claim names a real row with a matching live hash
  224 +    -- (catches forged claims, stale claims, and pack/invented rows).
  225 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_stale FROM public.poc_claim c WHERE c.run_id =
        p_run
  226 +      AND (c.table_name = 'poc_rule_pack_schedule'
  227 +           AND c.input_hash IS DISTINCT FROM public.poc_pack_claim_hash(
  228 +               c.employer_id, split_part(c.row_id, '|', 1), split_part(c.
       row_id, '|', 2)));
  229 +    SELECT count(*) + v_stale INTO v_stale FROM public.poc_claim c WHERE
       c.run_id = p_run
  230 +      AND c.table_name <> 'poc_rule_pack_schedule'
  231 +      AND c.input_hash IS DISTINCT FROM public.poc_src_hash(c.table_name,
        c.row_id::uuid);
  232 +    IF v_stale > 0 THEN
  233 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % claims stale or forged', v_
       stale
  234 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  235 +    END IF;
  236 +
  237 +    -- (b) Every expected source row is claimed (omission detection).
  238 +    -- Expected sets mirror the capture derivation exactly.
  239 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_missing FROM (
  240 +        -- population membership
  241 +        SELECT 'employee' AS t, m.id::text AS r FROM public.employee m
  242 +         WHERE m.employer_id = v_employer
  243 +        UNION ALL
  244 +        -- overlapping terms
  245 +        SELECT 'employment_terms', t.id::text FROM public.employment_term
       s t
  246 +         WHERE t.employer_id = v_employer
  247 +           AND daterange(t.effective_from, COALESCE(t.effective_to, 'infi
       nity'::date), '[]')
  248 +               && daterange(v_start, v_end, '[]')
  249 +        UNION ALL
  250 +        -- approved sheets for the period
  251 +        SELECT 'timesheet', s.id::text FROM public.timesheet s
  252 +         WHERE s.employer_id = v_employer AND s.pay_period_id = v_period
       AND s.status = 'approved'
  253 +        UNION ALL
  254 +        -- current work intervals in the period
  255 +        SELECT 'attendance_interval', i.id::text FROM public.attendance_i
       nterval i
  256 +         WHERE i.employer_id = v_employer AND i.is_current AND i.kind = '
       work'
  257 +           AND i.local_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
  258 +        UNION ALL
  259 +        -- decided leave overlapping the period
  260 +        SELECT 'leave_request', l.id::text FROM public.leave_request l
  261 +         WHERE l.employer_id = v_employer AND l.status IN ('approved', 'r
       ejected')
  262 +           AND daterange(l.from_date, l.to_date, '[]') && daterange(v_sta
       rt, v_end, '[]')
  263 +        UNION ALL
  264 +        -- overlapping comp lines
  265 +        SELECT 'compensation_line', c.id::text FROM public.compensation_l
       ine c
  266 +         WHERE c.employer_id = v_employer
  267 +           AND daterange(c.effective_from, COALESCE(c.effective_to, 'infi
       nity'::date), '[]')
  268 +               && daterange(v_start, v_end, '[]')
  269 +    ) exp
  270 +    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.poc_claim c
  271 +                       WHERE c.run_id = p_run AND c.table_name = exp.t AN
       D c.row_id = exp.r);
  272 +    -- pack pins claimed by "pack|version" row identity
  273 +    SELECT v_missing + count(*) INTO v_missing
  274 +      FROM public.poc_rule_pack_schedule s
  275 +     WHERE s.employer_id = v_employer
  276 +       AND daterange(s.effective_from, s.effective_to, '[]') && daterange
       (v_start, v_end, '[]')
  277 +       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.poc_claim c
  278 +                        WHERE c.run_id = p_run AND c.table_name = 'poc_ru
       le_pack_schedule'
  279 +                          AND c.row_id = s.pack || '|' || s.version);
  280 +    IF v_missing > 0 THEN
  281 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % expected source rows unclai
       med', v_missing
  282 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  283 +    END IF;
  284 +
  285 +    -- (c) No orphan claims (claimed row not in any expected set).
  286 +    -- (Covered by (a)+(b) jointly for known tables; this pins the
  287 +    -- table-name allowlist itself.)
  288 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_orphan FROM public.poc_claim c WHERE c.run_id
       = p_run
  289 +      AND c.table_name NOT IN ('employee', 'employment_terms', 'timesheet
       ',
  290 +          'attendance_interval', 'leave_request', 'compensation_line',
  291 +          'poc_rule_pack_schedule');
  292 +    IF v_orphan > 0 THEN
  293 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % claims outside the source a
       llowlist', v_orphan
  294 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  295 +    END IF;
  296 +
  297 +    -- (d) Member-to-source relationships: every member's pinned
  298 +    -- references must belong to that member's employee + period.
  299 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_badrel FROM public.payroll_snapshot_employee e
  300 +     WHERE e.snapshot_id = p_snapshot AND (
  301 +        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(e.employment_terms_ids) tid
  302 +                 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employment_terms
       t
  303 +                                    WHERE t.id = tid AND t.employee_id =
       e.employee_id))
  304 +        OR (e.approved_sheet_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
  305 +                SELECT 1 FROM public.timesheet s
  306 +                 WHERE s.id = e.approved_sheet_id AND s.employee_id = e.e
       mployee_id
  307 +                   AND s.pay_period_id = v_period AND s.status = 'approve
       d'))
  308 +     );
  309 +    IF v_badrel > 0 THEN
  310 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % members with invalid source
        relations', v_badrel
  311 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  312 +    END IF;
  313 +
  314 +    -- (e) Decision re-derivation: recompute every member decision from
  315 +    -- LIVE tables and require equality with the recorded one.
  316 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_baddec FROM public.payroll_snapshot_employee e
  317 +     JOIN public.employee m ON m.id = e.employee_id, LATERAL (
  318 +        SELECT CASE
  319 +            WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT t.monthly_basic)
  320 +                    FROM public.employment_terms t
  321 +                   WHERE t.employee_id = e.employee_id
  322 +                     AND daterange(t.effective_from, COALESCE(t.effective
       _to, 'infinity'::date), '[]')
  323 +                         && daterange(v_start, v_end, '[]')) > 1 THEN 'ex
       cluded'
  324 +            WHEN e.approved_sheet_id IS NULL
  325 +             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_interval i
  326 +                          WHERE i.employee_id = e.employee_id AND i.is_cu
       rrent AND i.kind = 'work'
  327 +                            AND i.local_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end) T
       HEN 'missing-timesheet'
  328 +            ELSE 'included' END AS want
  329 +     ) d
  330 +     WHERE e.snapshot_id = p_snapshot AND e.decision IS DISTINCT FROM d.w
       ant;
  331 +    IF v_baddec > 0 THEN
  332 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % member decisions disagree w
       ith live derivation', v_baddec
  333 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  334 +    END IF;
  335 +
  336 +    -- (f) Joint pack coverage: every period day covered by >= 1 pin.
  337 +    SELECT count(*) INTO v_uncovered FROM generate_series(v_start, v_end,
        '1 day') d
  338 +     WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  339 +        SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_snapshot_pack p
  340 +         WHERE p.snapshot_id = p_snapshot
  341 +           AND d::date BETWEEN p.effective_from AND p.effective_to);
  342 +    IF v_uncovered > 0 THEN
  343 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_verify_claims: % period days without pack co
       verage', v_uncovered
  344 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  345 +    END IF;
  346 +END;

  +-- as the DEFINER owner inside authorized transactions.

  +-- ============================================================ Part 5 ==
  +-- Authorized snapshot capture (the PG-1 fix).
  +--
  +-- The ONLY writer of snapshot/claim/run rows on this database. Derives
  +-- EVERYTHING from authoritative tables inside the caller's transaction
  +-- (the DBOS capture txn holds the employer gate throughout):
  +-- population, terms, sheets, intervals, leave, comp lines, pack pins,
  +-- decisions, blockers, row hashes, content hash. Caller supplies only
  +-- employer + period code + actor attribution; membership, inputs,
  +-- pins, digests and status are never caller-supplied.
  +--
  +-- POC rules (explicit, derived, reviewable):
  +-- - One regular run per employer+period; capture runs once per run.
  +-- - Population = every employee of the employer (ordered by no).
  +-- - >1 distinct monthly basic overlapping the period -> 'excluded'
  +--   with blocker B-BASE-CHANGE (proration is BLOCKED, never silent).
  +-- - Approved sheet missing but worked minutes exist ->

  +-- - No sheet and no minutes -> 'included' with zero inputs.
  +-- - Leave day carrying worked minutes -> day excluded in inputs
  +--   (blocker B-LEAVE-WORKED on the day, employee stays included).
  +CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poc_snapshot_capture(
  +    p_employer uuid, p_period_code text, p_actor text,
  +    OUT o_run_id uuid, OUT o_snapshot_id uuid, OUT o_content_hash text)
  +RETURNS record LANGUAGE plpgsql
  +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  +DECLARE
  +    v_period uuid; v_start date; v_end date; v_pstatus text;
  +    v_run uuid; v_snap uuid;
  +    v_members int := 0;
  +    v_canon text := '';
  +    emp record;
  +    v_terms uuid[]; v_nbases int; v_base_cents bigint;
  +    v_sheet uuid; v_haswork boolean;
  +    v_decision text; v_blockers jsonb;
  +    v_days jsonb; v_rowtext text; v_rowhash text;
  +    v_status_ids uuid[]; v_comp jsonb;
  +    v_allow_cents bigint; v_deduct_cents bigint;
  +BEGIN
  +    IF p_actor IS NULL OR length(trim(p_actor)) = 0 THEN
  +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_snapshot_capture: actor attribution required';
  +    END IF;
  +    SELECT p.id, p.starts_on, p.ends_on, p.status
  +      INTO v_period, v_start, v_end, v_pstatus
  +      FROM public.pay_period p
  +     WHERE p.employer_id = p_employer AND p.code = p_period_code;

  +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_snapshot_capture: period % is %', p_period_code,

  +    -- same keys the writer triggers take (Part 7).
  +    PERFORM public.poc_gate_acquire(p_employer);
  +    PERFORM public.acquire_payroll_population_lock(p_employer);

  +    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payroll_run r

  +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  +    END IF;

  +     ORDER BY r.created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;

  +    END IF;

  +    CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE pg_auth_pins ON COMMIT DROP AS

o

  890 +-- Authorized run validation (finalization gate).
  891 +--
  892 +-- Re-verifies against LIVE tables (not recorded labels): exactly one
  893 +-- valid tip, claims verifier green, header binding recomputed from
  894 +-- current members+pins, approval present, output recorded. The frozen
  895 +-- run_lifecycle trigger re-checks as a backstop on the UPDATE.
  896 +CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poc_run_validate(p_run uuid, p_actor text)
  897 +RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql
  898 +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  899 +DECLARE
  900 +    v_employer uuid; v_period uuid; v_pcode text; v_status text;
  901 +    v_tip uuid; v_tiphash text; v_recomputed text;
  902 +BEGIN
  903 +    IF p_actor IS NULL OR length(trim(p_actor)) = 0 THEN
  904 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: actor attribution required';
  905 +    END IF;
  906 +    SELECT r.employer_id, r.pay_period_id, r.status
  907 +      INTO v_employer, v_period, v_status
  908 +      FROM public.payroll_run r WHERE r.id = p_run FOR UPDATE;
  909 +    IF NOT FOUND THEN
  910 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: run % unknown', p_run;
  911 +    END IF;
  912 +    IF v_status <> 'draft' THEN
  913 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: run is %, want draft', v_statu
       s;
  914 +    END IF;
  915 +    SELECT p.code INTO v_pcode FROM public.pay_period p WHERE p.id = v_pe
       riod;
  916 +    PERFORM public.poc_gate_acquire(v_employer);
  917 +
  918 +    SELECT s.id, s.content_hash INTO v_tip, v_tiphash
  919 +      FROM public.payroll_snapshot s WHERE s.payroll_run_id = p_run AND s
       .status = 'valid';
  920 +    IF NOT FOUND THEN
  921 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: no valid snapshot tip' USING E
       RRCODE = 'P0001';
  922 +    END IF;
  923 +    -- Live re-verification (claims, relations, decisions, coverage).
  924 +    PERFORM public.poc_verify_claims(p_run, v_tip);
  925 +    -- Header binding recomputed from CURRENT members + pins.
  926 +    SELECT pg_catalog.encode(public.digest(
  927 +        v_employer::text || '|' || v_pcode || '|' || p_run::text || '|' |
       |
  928 +        (SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(m.employee_no || ':' || e.row_hash,
        ';' ORDER BY m.employee_no)
  929 +           FROM public.payroll_snapshot_employee e
  930 +           JOIN public.employee m ON m.id = e.employee_id
  931 +          WHERE e.snapshot_id = v_tip) || ';' ||
  932 +        (SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.string_agg(
  933 +                   p.pack || '|' || p.version || '|' || p.manifest_digest
       , ';'
  934 +                   ORDER BY p.effective_from, p.pack), '')
  935 +           FROM public.payroll_snapshot_pack p WHERE p.snapshot_id = v_ti
       p),
  936 +        'sha256'), 'hex')
  937 +      INTO v_recomputed;
  938 +    IF v_recomputed IS DISTINCT FROM v_tiphash THEN
  939 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: header binding mismatch (membe
       rs or pins changed)'
  940 +            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  941 +    END IF;
  942 +    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.poc_approval a
  943 +                    WHERE a.run_id = p_run AND a.decision = 'approve') TH
       EN
  944 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: no recorded approval' USING ER
       RCODE = 'P0001';
  945 +    END IF;
  946 +    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.poc_run_output o WHERE o.run_id =
        p_run) THEN
  947 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_run_validate: no persisted output digest' US
       ING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  948 +    END IF;
  949 +    UPDATE public.payroll_run r SET status = 'validated' WHERE r.id = p_r
       un;
  950 +    INSERT INTO public.audit_event (employer_id, actor, service, action,
       entity, entity_id)
  951 +    VALUES (v_employer, p_actor, 'payroll', 'run.validate', 'payroll_run'
       , p_run);
  952 +    RETURN 'validated';
  953 +END;

  1043 +-- Writer participation trigger, rewritten (replaces the
  1044 +-- gate2_poc.sql version):
  1045 +-- - DEFINER (owner): writers reach the gate ONLY through triggers;
  1046 +--   direct app EXECUTE on poc_gate_acquire is revoked (Part 2).
  1047 +-- - Covers INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE (DELETE bypass closed, PG-10a).
  1048 +-- - Cross-employer UPDATE takes both employer keys in sorted order
  1049 +--   (PG-10b); single-employer writes take one key.
  1050 +-- - Closed-period rejection uses poc_writer_period_code (PG-3 fix);
  1051 +--   unmapped tables are gate-only (see above).
  1052 +-- DROP + CREATE: OR REPLACE cannot change the security attribute.
  1053 +DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.poc_require_gate() CASCADE;
  1054 +CREATE FUNCTION poc_require_gate()
  1055 +RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql
  1056 +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  1057 +DECLARE
  1058 +    v_row jsonb; v_employer uuid; v_old uuid;
  1059 +    v_first uuid; v_second uuid;
  1060 +    v_code text; v_closed boolean;
  1061 +BEGIN
  1062 +    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
  1063 +        v_row := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(OLD);
  1064 +    ELSE
  1065 +        v_row := pg_catalog.to_jsonb(NEW);
  1066 +    END IF;
  1067 +    v_employer := (v_row->>'employer_id')::uuid;
  1068 +    IF v_employer IS NULL THEN
  1069 +        RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_require_gate: no employer identity on %', T
        G_TABLE_NAME;
  1070 +    END IF;
  1071 +    -- Sorted dual-key acquisition for cross-employer UPDATE.
  1072 +    v_first := v_employer; v_second := NULL;
  1073 +    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
  1074 +        v_old := (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(OLD)->>'employer_id')::uuid;
  1075 +        IF v_old IS DISTINCT FROM v_employer AND v_old IS NOT NULL THEN
  1076 +            IF v_old < v_employer THEN
  1077 +                v_first := v_old; v_second := v_employer;
  1078 +            ELSE
  1079 +                v_first := v_employer; v_second := v_old;
  1080 +            END IF;
  1081 +        END IF;
  1082 +    END IF;
  1083 +    -- Closed-period rejection via real period relationships.
  1084 +    v_code := public.poc_writer_period_code(TG_TABLE_NAME, v_row);
  1085 +    IF v_code IS NOT NULL THEN
  1086 +        SELECT EXISTS (
  1087 +            SELECT 1 FROM public.poc_period_close c
  1088 +             WHERE c.employer_id = v_employer AND c.period = v_code
  1089 +               AND c.closed_at IS NOT NULL
  1090 +        ) INTO v_closed;
  1091 +        IF v_closed THEN
  1092 +            RAISE EXCEPTION 'poc_require_gate: period % closed for emplo
        yer %', v_code, v_employer
  1093 +                USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  1094 +        END IF;
  1095 +    END IF;
  1096 +    PERFORM public.poc_gate_acquire(v_first);
  1097 +    IF v_second IS NOT NULL THEN
  1098 +        PERFORM public.poc_gate_acquire(v_second);
  1099 +    END IF;
  1100 +    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
  1101 +        RETURN OLD;
  1102 +    END IF;
  1103 +    RETURN NEW;
  1104 +END;
  1105 +$fn$;
  1106 +ALTER FUNCTION poc_require_gate() OWNER TO migration_admin;
  1107 +REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION poc_require_gate() FROM PUBLIC;

  1109 +-- owner regardless of the invoking role).

  171 +func mustFailClosed(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool, label, sql string,
       codes ...string) {
  172 +    t.Helper()
  173 +    if _, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), sql); err == nil {
  174 +        t.Fatalf("%s accepted, want rejection", label)
  175 +    } else {
  176 +        ok := false
  177 +        for _, c := range codes {
  178 +            if strings.Contains(err.Error(), c) {
  179 +                ok = true
  180 +            }
  181 +        }
  182 +        if !ok {
  183 +            t.Fatalf("%s: want one of %v, got: %v", label, codes, err)
  184 +        }
  185 +    }
  186 +}

    1 +# Production migration proposal (prompt8 remediation companion)
    2 +
    3 +Status: PROPOSAL ONLY — no migration file created, frozen 00001–00012
    4 +untouched, no 00013. This document describes the reviewed-production
    5 +equivalent of `poc/payroll-month/gate/pg_authority.sql` (disposable-DB
    6 +overlay, already executed there). Each item needs independent review,
    7 +a staged rollout plan, and the existing battery green before it can
    8 +become a real migration.
    9 +
   10 +## 1. Revoke direct application write on authoritative tables
   11 +
   12 +- `payroll_snapshot`, `payroll_snapshot_employee`,
   13 +  `payroll_snapshot_pack`: app keeps SELECT; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
   14 +  revoked (UPDATE/DELETE already revoked by 00012; INSERT is the
   15 +  change — the 00012 verify block asserting INSERT must be updated
   16 +  in the same migration).
   17 +- `payroll_run`: app keeps SELECT + INSERT (draft creation moves to
   18 +  the DEFINER; see §3 — then INSERT is revoked too).
   19 +- `payroll_line`, `payslip`: app keeps SELECT; all writes revoked.
   20 +- New control tables (`poc_claim` → `payroll_claim`,
   21 +  `poc_period_close` → `payroll_period_close`,
   22 +  `poc_rule_pack_schedule` → `rule_pack_schedule`,
   23 +  `poc_run_output`, `poc_approval`, outbox, backlink): app SELECT
   24 +  (and guarded UPDATE on the outbox state machine) only.
   25 +
   26 +## 2. Structural corrections
   27 +
   28 +- `payroll_snapshot_pack` PK `(snapshot_id, pack)` →
   29 +  `(snapshot_id, pack, version)`: a mid-period pack change pins two
   30 +  versions truthfully. No FK dependents (verified: readers use
   31 +  plain SELECT).
   32 +- New `rule_pack_schedule` table (effective-dated, overlap-free per
   33 +  pack via exclusion constraint): the frozen `rule_pack_activation`
   34 +  holds one version per pack and cannot represent the October
   35 +  v1a→v2a change. Migration seeds it from reviewed rule data (never
   36 +  from POC fixture JSON without re-verification).
   37 +- Outbox states extended to
   38 +  pending/appended/backlinked/failed/reconciling/reconciled/poison
   39 +  with the transition-guard trigger (evidence identity immutable,
   40 +  attempts never rewind, anchored tx immutable).
   41 +- Backlink PK `(pg_table, pg_id)` →
   42 +  `(pg_table, pg_id, event_uuid)`: one row per evidence event so
   43 +  corrections append instead of conflicting.
   44 +
   45 +## 3. Authorized operations (all SECURITY DEFINER, owner
   46 +## migration_admin, search_path pg_catalog, explicit EXECUTE)
   47 +
   48 +- `snapshot_capture(employer, period_code, actor)`: derives
   49 +  population/terms/sheets/intervals/leave/comp/pins/decisions/hashes
   50 +  from authoritative tables; writes header, members, pins, claims,
   51 +  run derived fields; calls the verifier in-transaction. The sole
   52 +  writer of snapshot/claim/run rows.
   53 +- `verify_claims(run, snapshot)`: both-directions check over real
   54 +  source relationships (stale/forged claims, omissions, orphan
   55 +  tables, member↔source relations, re-derived decisions, joint pack
   56 +  coverage); vacuous evidence rejected. EXECUTE withheld from app.
   57 +- `result_persist(run, calc_version, input_digest, lines, payslips,
   58 +  actor)`: binds results to the tip hash + pinned calc version;
   59 +  included-members only; exact-cents arithmetic; recomputes the
   60 +  output digest.
   61 +- `approve(run, approver, decision, note)`: requires persisted
   62 +  results and zero missing-timesheet members.
   63 +- `run_validate(run, actor)`: live re-verification + recomputed
   64 +  header binding + approval + output checks, then draft→validated
   65 +  (the frozen `run_lifecycle` trigger stays as a backstop).
   66 +- `close_period(employer, period, run)`: validated-run required,
   67 +  DB-clock timestamp, period row locked, duplicate close rejected.
   68 +- `outbox_enqueue(employer, run, event_uuid, actor)`: validated-run
   69 +  required; payload derived from persisted artifacts; same-op
   70 +  replay converges, differing payload rejected loudly.
   71 +- `backlink_record(table, id, event, tx, alh)`: requires a matching
   72 +  appended/reconciling outbox row; exact replays converge,
   73 +  conflicts rejected loudly.
   74 +
   75 +## 4. Writer participation
   76 +
   77 +- `require_gate()` trigger function becomes DEFINER; direct app
   78 +  EXECUTE on the gate function revoked (writers reach the gate via
   79 +  triggers only).
   80 +- Triggers cover INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all capture-input tables

  381 +-- Read-only consistency probe (Phase C input-drift detection).
  382 +-- Compares LIVE source hashes against the run's recorded claims by
  383 +-- reusing the verifier (zero derivation duplication): returns
  384 +-- 'consistent', or 'changed: <first defect>' when any source row was
  385 +-- added, removed, or altered after capture. Duplicate workflow
  386 +-- attempts adopt on 'consistent' and raise an explicit conflict
  387 +-- otherwise — never a silent stale replay (DB-3 fix).
  388 +CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION poc_run_consistency(p_run uuid)
  389 +RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql
  390 +    SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $fn$
  391 +DECLARE
  392 +    v_tip uuid;
  393 +BEGIN
  394 +    SELECT s.id INTO v_tip FROM public.payroll_snapshot s
  395 +     WHERE s.payroll_run_id = p_run AND s.status = 'valid';
  396 +    IF NOT FOUND THEN
  397 +        RETURN 'changed: no valid snapshot tip';
  398 +    END IF;
  399 +    BEGIN
  400 +        PERFORM public.poc_verify_claims(p_run, v_tip);
  401 +    EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'P0001' THEN
  402 +        RETURN 'changed: ' || SQLERRM;
  403 +    END;
  404 +    RETURN 'consistent';
  405 +END;

  57 +func MonthPayrollDigest(m Month) (string, error) {

  80 +    if err != nil {
  81 +        return "", err
  82 +    }

  129 +// PacksToRulePacks parses pinned schedule params into synth packs.
  130 +// Params JSON uses the exact synth.RulePack field tags.
  131 +func PacksToRulePacks(pins []SnapPin) ([]synth.RulePack, error) {
  132 +    var packs []synth.RulePack
  133 +    for _, pn := range pins {
  134 +        var rp synth.RulePack
  135 +        if err := json.Unmarshal(pn.ParamsRaw, &rp); err != nil {

       , err)
  137 +        }

  139 +            return nil, fmt.Errorf("calc: pin %s binds params %s", pn.Ver
       sion, rp.Version)
  140 +        }
  141 +        packs = append(packs, rp)
  142 +    }
  143 +    return packs, nil
  144 +}

  146 +// CalcMember runs one included member through synth.ComputePay.
  147 +// Excluded members return a BlockedEmp (no financial effect).
  148 +// Day exclusion mirrors Canonical: excluded days are skipped and
  149 +// recorded as day exceptions (never silently processed, never guessed).
  150 +func CalcMember(mb SnapMember, packs []synth.RulePack, allowCents, deduct
       Cents int64) (workload.EmpResult, *workload.BlockedEmp, []workload.Except
       ion, error) {
  151 +    if mb.Decision != "included" {
  152 +        code := "B-UNKNOWN"
  153 +        if len(mb.Blockers) > 0 {
  154 +            code = mb.Blockers[0].Code
  155 +        }
  156 +        return workload.EmpResult{}, &workload.BlockedEmp{
  157 +            ID: mb.EmployeeNo, Blocked: true,
  158 +            Block: &workload.Block{Code: code},
  159 +        }, nil, nil
  160 +    }
  161 +    if mb.Inputs.MonthlyBaseCents == nil {
  162 +        return workload.EmpResult{}, nil, nil,
  163 +            fmt.Errorf("calc: included member %s has no monthly base", mb
       .EmployeeNo)
  164 +    }
  165 +    var inputs []synth.DayInput
  166 +    var exc []workload.Exception
  167 +    for _, d := range mb.Inputs.Days {
  168 +        if d.Excluded {
  169 +            exc = append(exc, workload.Exception{
  170 +                Scope: "day", Ref: mb.EmployeeNo + "/" + d.Date,
  171 +                Code: workload.CodeLeaveWorked,
  172 +            })
  173 +            continue
  174 +        }
  175 +        inputs = append(inputs, synth.DayInput{
  176 +            Day: d.Date, WorkedMin: d.Minutes, OnUnpaidLeave: d.Leave,
  177 +            MonthlyBaseCents: *mb.Inputs.MonthlyBaseCents,
  178 +        })
  179 +    }
  180 +    res, err := synth.ComputePay(inputs, packs)
  181 +    if err != nil {
  182 +        return workload.EmpResult{}, nil, nil,
  183 +            fmt.Errorf("calc: ComputePay %s: %w", mb.EmployeeNo, err)
  184 +    }
  185 +    return workload.EmpResult{
  186 +        ID: mb.EmployeeNo, MonthlyBaseCents: *mb.Inputs.MonthlyBaseCents,
  187 +        Days: res.Days, TotalOTCents: res.TotalOTCents,
  188 +        TotalDedCents: res.TotalDedCents, AllowCents: allowCents,
  189 +        DeductCents: deductCents,
  190 +        NetCents: *mb.Inputs.MonthlyBaseCents + res.TotalOTCents -
  191 +            res.TotalDedCents + allowCents - deductCents,
  192 +        Digest: res.Digest,
  193 +    }, nil, exc, nil
  194 +}
  195 +
  196 +// CalcMonth runs the whole snapshot: every member through CalcMember,
  197 +// then the shared payroll digest. allowCents/deductCents come from
  198 +// the member's captured as-given sums (never re-derived).
  199 +func CalcMonth(members []SnapMember, packs []synth.RulePack, period, empl
       oyer string) (workload.Month, string, error) {
  200 +    m := workload.Month{
  201 +        CanonicalVersion: "poc-canonical-v1", Period: period, Employer: e
       mployer,
  202 +        Packs: packs,
  203 +    }
  204 +    for _, mb := range members {
  205 +        er, blocked, exc, err := CalcMember(mb, packs, mb.Inputs.AllowCen
       ts, mb.Inputs.DeductCents)
  206 +        if err != nil {
  207 +            return workload.Month{}, "", err
  208 +        }
  209 +        m.Exceptions = append(m.Exceptions, exc...)
  210 +        if blocked != nil {
  211 +            m.Blocked = append(m.Blocked, *blocked)
  212 +            continue
  213 +        }
  214 +        m.Employees = append(m.Employees, er)
  215 +    }
  216 +    digest, err := workload.MonthPayrollDigest(m)
  217 +    if err != nil {
  218 +        return workload.Month{}, "", err
  219 +    }
  220 +    return m, digest, nil
  221 +}

    3 +// Stages A-G payroll workflow (prompt8 §4.1): the DBOS connective
    4 +// tissue between PostgreSQL authority (Part 5/6 DEFINERs) and the
    5 +// ledger evidence path. Every authoritative write runs inside

  132 +func isAlreadyCaptured(err error) bool {
  133 +    var pgErr *pgconn.PgError
  134 +    return err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "already captured"
       ) &&
  135 +        (pgErr == nil || true) && isP0001(err)
  136 +}
  137 +
  138 +func isP0001(err error) bool {
  139 +    var pgErr *pgconn.PgError
  140 +    if e, ok := err.(*pgconn.PgError); ok {
  141 +        pgErr = e
  142 +        _ = pgErr
  143 +        return e.Code == "P0001"
  144 +    }
  145 +    return strings.Contains(err.Error(), "P0001")
  146 +}

  148 +// stageBCapture resolves the attempt to a business run (Stage B):
  149 +// fresh capture, consistent adopt, or explicit conflict. Runs inside
  150 +// the caller's transaction (business rows + attempt claim + DBOS
  151 +// checkpoint commit together).
  152 +func stageBCapture(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, workflowID string, in
        PayrollInput, r readiness) (captureOut, error) {
  153 +    var out captureOut
  154 +    actor := "dbos:" + workflowID + ":" + in.RequestedBy
  155 +    // Existing run? (FOR UPDATE serializes attempts on the same run.)
  156 +    var runID, status string
  157 +    err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  158 +        `SELECT id, status FROM payroll_run
  159 +          WHERE employer_id = $1 AND pay_period_id =
  160 +            (SELECT id FROM pay_period WHERE employer_id = $1 AND code =
       $2)
  161 +            AND kind = 'regular' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE`,
  162 +        r.EmployerID, r.PeriodCode).Scan(&runID, &status)
  163 +    switch {
  164 +    case err == nil && status == "validated":
  165 +        return adoptOrConflict(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r, runID)
  166 +    case err == nil:
  167 +        // Draft: capture if uncaptured, else adopt-or-conflict.
  168 +        var tip string
  169 +        if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  170 +            `SELECT id FROM payroll_snapshot WHERE payroll_run_id = $1 AN
       D status = 'valid'`,
  171 +            runID).Scan(&tip); err == nil {
  172 +            return adoptOrConflict(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r, runID)
  173 +        }
  174 +    }
  175 +    // Fresh capture under a savepoint (a lost race rolls back to the
  176 +    // savepoint and adopts instead of poisoning this transaction).
  177 +    if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SAVEPOINT p8_capture`); err != nil {
  178 +        return out, err
  179 +    }
  180 +    var snapID, digest string
  181 +    err = tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  182 +        `SELECT * FROM poc_snapshot_capture($1, $2, $3)`,
  183 +        r.EmployerID, r.PeriodCode, actor).Scan(&runID, &snapID, &digest)
  184 +    if err != nil {
  185 +        if isAlreadyCaptured(err) {
  186 +            if _, rb := tx.Exec(ctx, `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT p8_capture`);
        rb != nil {
  187 +                return out, rb
  188 +            }
  189 +            return adoptAfterRace(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r)
  190 +        }
  191 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("capture: %w", err)
  192 +    }
  193 +    if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `RELEASE SAVEPOINT p8_capture`); err != nil
        {
  194 +        return out, err
  195 +    }
  196 +    if err := claimAttempt(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r, runID, digest, "ca
       ptured"); err != nil {
  197 +        return out, err
  198 +    }
  199 +    return captureOut{RunID: runID, SnapshotID: snapID, InputDigest: dige
       st, Role: "captured"}, nil
  200 +}
  201 +
  202 +// adoptAfterRace re-resolves after losing a capture race.
  203 +func adoptAfterRace(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, workflowID string, i
       n PayrollInput, r readiness) (captureOut, error) {
  204 +    var out captureOut
  205 +    var runID string
  206 +    err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  207 +        `SELECT id FROM payroll_run
  208 +          WHERE employer_id = $1 AND pay_period_id =
  209 +            (SELECT id FROM pay_period WHERE employer_id = $1 AND code =
       $2)
  210 +            AND kind = 'regular' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE`,
  211 +        r.EmployerID, r.PeriodCode).Scan(&runID)
  212 +    if err != nil {
  213 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("adopt after race: run vanished: %w", err)
  214 +    }
  215 +    return adoptOrConflict(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r, runID)
  216 +}
  217 +
  218 +// adoptOrConflict implements the DB-3 rule: consistent live inputs
  219 +// adopt the existing verified run; changed inputs raise an explicit
  220 +// input-version conflict (never a silent stale replay).
  221 +func adoptOrConflict(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, workflowID string,
       in PayrollInput, r readiness, runID string) (captureOut, error) {
  222 +    var out captureOut
  223 +    var consistency string
  224 +    if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  225 +        `SELECT poc_run_consistency($1)`, runID).Scan(&consistency); err
       != nil {
  226 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("adopt: consistency probe: %w", err)
  227 +    }
  228 +    if consistency != "consistent" {
  229 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("input-version conflict on run %s: %s (ope
       n a new revision; finalized results are never silently replaced)", runID,
        consistency)
  230 +    }
  231 +    var snapID, digest string
  232 +    if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  233 +        `SELECT id, content_hash FROM payroll_snapshot
  234 +          WHERE payroll_run_id = $1 AND status = 'valid'`, runID).Scan(&s
       napID, &digest); err != nil {
  235 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("adopt: tip lookup: %w", err)
  236 +    }
  237 +    if err := claimAttempt(ctx, tx, workflowID, in, r, runID, digest, "ad
       opted"); err != nil {
  238 +        return out, err
  239 +    }
  240 +    return captureOut{RunID: runID, SnapshotID: snapID, InputDigest: dige
       st, Role: "adopted"}, nil
  241 +}
  242 +
  243 +func claimAttempt(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, workflowID string, in
       PayrollInput, r readiness, runID, digest, role string) error {
  244 +    _, err := tx.Exec(ctx,
  245 +        `INSERT INTO poc_workflow_attempt (workflow_id, run_id, employer_
       id, period_code, role, input_digest)
  246 +         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
  247 +        workflowID, runID, r.EmployerID, r.PeriodCode, role, digest)
  248 +    return err
  249 +}

  260 +// calcStep runs Stage C: snapshot → ComputePay → persist JSON.
  261 +func calcStep(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, cap captureOut, r
       readiness, employerCode string) (calcOut, error) {
  262 +    var out calcOut
  263 +    members, pins, err := LoadSnapshot(ctx, pool, cap.RunID)
  264 +    if err != nil {
  265 +        return out, err
  266 +    }
  267 +    packs, err := PacksToRulePacks(pins)
  268 +    if err != nil {
  269 +        return out, err
  270 +    }
  271 +    m, digest, err := CalcMonth(members, packs, "2026-10", employerCode)
  272 +    if err != nil {
  273 +        return out, err
  274 +    }
  275 +    // Join results to members (CalcMonth preserves member order).
  276 +    type line struct {
  277 +        EmployeeNo          string         `json:"employee_no"`
  278 +        Component           string         `json:"component"`
  279 +        PayCode             string         `json:"pay_code"`
  280 +        Hours               *float64       `json:"hours"`
  281 +        AmountCents         int64          `json:"amount_cents"`
  282 +        CPFTreatment        string         `json:"cpf_treatment"`
  283 +        WorkPeriod          string         `json:"work_period"`
  284 +        PayableDate         string         `json:"payable_date"`
  285 +        ContributionPeriod  string         `json:"contribution_period"`
  286 +        SourceRefs          map[string]any `json:"source_refs"`
  287 +    }
  288 +    type slip struct {
  289 +        EmployeeNo string         `json:"employee_no"`
  290 +        Payload    map[string]any `json:"payload"`
  291 +    }
  292 +    packVers := map[string]any{}
  293 +    for _, pn := range pins {
  294 +        packVers[pn.Pack] = pn.Version
  295 +    }
  296 +    var lines []line
  297 +    var slips []slip
  298 +    er := 0
  299 +    for _, mb := range members {
  300 +        if mb.Decision != "included" {
  301 +            continue
  302 +        }
  303 +        res := m.Employees[er]
  304 +        er++
  305 +        termsID := ""
  306 +        if len(mb.Inputs.TermsIDs) > 0 {
  307 +            termsID = mb.Inputs.TermsIDs[0]
  308 +        }
  309 +        refs := map[string]any{
  310 +            "timesheet_line_ids": []string{},
  311 +            "terms_id":           termsID,
  312 +            "rule_pack_versions": packVers,
  313 +            "calculation":        map[string]any{"emp_digest": res.Digest
       , "calc": CalcVersion},
  314 +        }
  315 +        mk := func(comp, code string, cents int64, cpf string) {
  316 +            if cents == 0 {
  317 +                return
  318 +            }
  319 +            lines = append(lines, line{
  320 +                EmployeeNo: res.ID, Component: comp, PayCode: code,
  321 +                AmountCents: cents, CPFTreatment: cpf,
  322 +                WorkPeriod: "2026-10", PayableDate: r.PayDate,
  323 +                ContributionPeriod: "2026-10", SourceRefs: refs,
  324 +            })
  325 +        }
  326 +        mk("basic", "REG", res.MonthlyBaseCents, "OW")
  327 +        mk("overtime", "OT15", res.TotalOTCents, "OW")
  328 +        mk("leave", "LEAVE", -res.TotalDedCents, "NON_CPF_WAGE")
  329 +        mk("allowance", "ALLOW", res.AllowCents, "OW")
  330 +        mk("deduction", "DEDUCT", -res.DeductCents, "NON_CPF_WAGE")
  331 +        slips = append(slips, slip{EmployeeNo: res.ID, Payload: map[strin
       g]any{
  332 +            "net_cents": res.NetCents, "base_cents": res.MonthlyBaseCents
       ,
  333 +            "ot_cents": res.TotalOTCents, "leave_ded_cents": res.TotalDed
       Cents,
  334 +            "allow_cents": res.AllowCents, "deduct_cents": res.DeductCent
       s,
  335 +            "emp_digest": res.Digest, "calc_version": CalcVersion,
  336 +        }})
  337 +    }
  338 +    rawLines, err := json.Marshal(lines)
  339 +    if err != nil {
  340 +        return out, err
  341 +    }
  342 +    rawSlips, err := json.Marshal(slips)
  343 +    if err != nil {
  344 +        return out, err
  345 +    }
  346 +    out = calcOut{Month: m, Digest: digest, LinesJSON: string(rawLines),
  347 +        PayslipsJSON: string(rawSlips), LineCount: len(lines)}
  348 +    return out, nil
  349 +}

  351 +// stageDPersist runs Stage D with convergent replay.
  352 +func stageDPersist(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, cap captureOut, calc
       calcOut, actor string) (string, error) {
  353 +    if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SAVEPOINT p8_persist`); err != nil {
  354 +        return "", err
  355 +    }
  356 +    var digest string
  357 +    err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  358 +        `SELECT poc_result_persist($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6)`
       ,
  359 +        cap.RunID, CalcVersion, cap.InputDigest, calc.LinesJSON, calc.Pay
       slipsJSON, actor).Scan(&digest)
  360 +    if err != nil {
  361 +        if isP0001(err) && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "already persist
       ed") {
  362 +            if _, rb := tx.Exec(ctx, `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT p8_persist`);
        rb != nil {
  363 +                return "", rb
  364 +            }
  365 +            if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  366 +                `SELECT output_digest FROM poc_run_output WHERE run_id =
       $1`,
  367 +                cap.RunID).Scan(&digest); err != nil {
  368 +                return "", fmt.Errorf("persist replay: output vanished: %
       w", err)
  369 +            }
  370 +            return digest, nil
  371 +        }
  372 +        return "", fmt.Errorf("persist: %w", err)
  373 +    }
  374 +    if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `RELEASE SAVEPOINT p8_persist`); err != nil
        {
  375 +        return "", err
  376 +    }
  377 +    return digest, nil
  378 +}
  379 +
  380 +// finalizeOut is the Stage F+G outcome.
  381 +type finalizeOut struct {
  382 +    Enqueue string
  383 +}
  384 +
  385 +// stageFFinalize runs Stages F+G in ONE transaction: validate, then
  386 +// enqueue the evidence event (event identity = the run UUID: stable
  387 +// across replays, unique per business run).
  388 +func stageFFinalize(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx, employerID, runID, a
       ctor string) (finalizeOut, error) {
  389 +    var out finalizeOut
  390 +    if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `SAVEPOINT p8_finalize`); err != nil {
  391 +        return out, err
  392 +    }
  393 +    var st string
  394 +    err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  395 +        `SELECT poc_run_validate($1, $2)`, runID, actor).Scan(&st)
  396 +    if err != nil {
  397 +        if isP0001(err) && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "want draft") {
  398 +            if _, rb := tx.Exec(ctx, `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT p8_finalize`)
       ; rb != nil {
  399 +                return out, rb
  400 +            }
  401 +            // Convergent replay: re-verify every finalization
  402 +            // precondition instead of trusting the label.
  403 +            var status string
  404 +            if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  405 +                `SELECT status FROM payroll_run WHERE id = $1`, runID).Sc
       an(&status); err != nil || status != "validated" {
  406 +                return out, fmt.Errorf("finalize replay: run status %q",
       status)
  407 +            }
  408 +            var n int
  409 +            if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  410 +                `SELECT count(*) FROM poc_run_output WHERE run_id = $1`,
       runID).Scan(&n); err != nil || n != 1 {
  411 +                return out, fmt.Errorf("finalize replay: output missing")
  412 +            }
  413 +            if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  414 +                `SELECT count(*) FROM poc_approval WHERE run_id = $1 AND
       decision = 'approve'`,
  415 +                runID).Scan(&n); err != nil || n != 1 {
  416 +                return out, fmt.Errorf("finalize replay: approval missing
       ")
  417 +            }
  418 +        } else {
  419 +            return out, fmt.Errorf("finalize validate: %w", err)
  420 +        }
  421 +    } else if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `RELEASE SAVEPOINT p8_finalize`); er
       r != nil {
  422 +        return out, err
  423 +    }
  424 +    if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx,
  425 +        `SELECT poc_outbox_enqueue($1, $2, $3, $4)`,
  426 +        employerID, runID, runID, actor).Scan(&out.Enqueue); err != nil {
  427 +        return out, fmt.Errorf("finalize enqueue: %w", err)
  428 +    }
  429 +    return out, nil
  430 +}

  432 +// PayrollWorkflow runs stages A through G for one payroll attempt.
  433 +func PayrollWorkflow(ctx dbos.Context, in PayrollInput) (PayrollResult, e
       rror) {
  434 +    var res PayrollResult
  435 +    wid, err := dbos.GetWorkflowID(ctx)
  436 +    if err != nil {
  437 +        return res, err
  438 +    }
  439 +    if in.EmployerCode == "" || in.PeriodCode == "" || in.RequestedBy ==
       "" {
  440 +        return res, fmt.Errorf("payroll: employer, period and requester a
       re required")
  441 +    }
  442 +    if Pool == nil || Datasource == nil {
  443 +        return res, fmt.Errorf("payroll: dbosflow pool/datasource not wir
       ed")
  444 +    }
  445 +    ready, err := dbos.RunAsStep(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) (readines
       s, error) {
  446 +        return checkReadiness(ctx, Pool, in.EmployerCode, in.PeriodCode)
  447 +    }, dbos.WithStepName("readiness"))
  448 +    if err != nil {
  449 +        return res, err
  450 +    }
  451 +    cap, err := dbos.RunAsTransaction(ctx, Datasource,
  452 +        func(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx) (captureOut, error) {
  453 +            return stageBCapture(ctx, tx, wid, in, ready)
  454 +        }, dbos.WithStepName("capture"))
  455 +    if err != nil {
  456 +        return res, err
  457 +    }
  458 +    calc, err := dbos.RunAsStep(ctx, func(ctx context.Context) (calcOut,
       error) {
  459 +        return calcStep(ctx, Pool, cap, ready, in.EmployerCode)
  460 +    }, dbos.WithStepName("calculate"))
  461 +    if err != nil {
  462 +        return res, err
  463 +    }
  464 +    actor := "dbos:" + wid + ":" + in.RequestedBy
  465 +    outDigest, err := dbos.RunAsTransaction(ctx, Datasource,
  466 +        func(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx) (string, error) {
  467 +            return stageDPersist(ctx, tx, cap, calc, actor)
  468 +        }, dbos.WithStepName("persist"))
  469 +    if err != nil {
  470 +        return res, err
  471 +    }
  472 +    timeout := in.ApprovalTimeout
  473 +    if timeout <= 0 {
  474 +        timeout = DefaultApprovalTimeout
  475 +    }
  476 +    msg, err := dbos.Recv[ApprovalMsg](ctx, ApprovalTopic(cap.RunID), tim
       eout)
  477 +    if err != nil {
  478 +        return res, fmt.Errorf("approval wait for run %s: %w", cap.RunID,
        err)
  479 +    }
  480 +    if msg.Decision != "approve" {
  481 +        return res, fmt.Errorf("run %s rejected by %s: %s", cap.RunID, ms
       g.Approver, msg.Note)
  482 +    }
  483 +    fin, err := dbos.RunAsTransaction(ctx, Datasource,
  484 +        func(ctx context.Context, tx dbos.Tx) (finalizeOut, error) {
  485 +            return stageFFinalize(ctx, tx, ready.EmployerID, cap.RunID, a
       ctor)
  486 +        }, dbos.WithStepName("finalize"))
  487 +    if err != nil {
  488 +        return res, err
  489 +    }
  490 +    return PayrollResult{
  491 +        WorkflowID: wid, RunID: cap.RunID, SnapshotID: cap.SnapshotID,
  492 +        InputDigest: cap.InputDigest, OutputDigest: outDigest,
  493 +        PayrollDigest: calc.Digest, Role: cap.Role,
  494 +        Employees: len(calc.Month.Employees), Blocked: len(calc.Month.Blo
       cked),
  495 +        Lines: calc.LineCount, Validated: true, Enqueue: fin.Enqueue,
  496 +    }, nil
  497 +}

  348 +// approveCmd records an approval decision (authorized DEFINER op) and
  349 +// wakes the waiting workflow attempt via DBOS Send. Convergent: if the
  350 +// decision already stands, it re-sends the wake-up instead of failing.
  351 +func approveCmd(ctx context.Context, rep *Report, add func(string, bool,
       bool, string)) int {
  352 +    rep.Mode = "approve"
  353 +    dsn := os.Getenv("POC_DATABASE_URL")
  354 +    if dsn == "" {
  355 +        add("env:POC_DATABASE_URL", true, false, "unset")
  356 +        return finish(rep)
  357 +    }
  358 +    runID := flagValue("--run-id", "")
  359 +    decision := flagValue("--decision", "")
  360 +    approver := flagValue("--approver", "poc-operator")
  361 +    note := flagValue("--note", "")
  362 +    if runID == "" || (decision != "approve" && decision != "reject") {
  363 +        add("args", true, false, "need --run-id R --decision approve|reje
       ct [--approver A --note N]")
  364 +        return finish(rep)
  365 +    }
  366 +    pool, execCtx, cli, err := wireDBOS(ctx, dsn)
  367 +    if err != nil {
  368 +        add("dbos-wire", true, false, err.Error())
  369 +        return finish(rep)
  370 +    }
  371 +    defer dbosflow.ClosePoolTimeout(pool, 15*time.Second)
  372 +    defer func() { _ = execCtx.Shutdown(cli, 10*time.Second) }()
  373 +    if err := execCtx.Launch(); err != nil {
  374 +        add("dbos-launch", true, false, err.Error())
  375 +        return finish(rep)
  376 +    }
  377 +    // Resolve the waiting attempt (the Recv destination).
  378 +    var wid string
  379 +    if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx,
  380 +        `SELECT a.workflow_id FROM poc_workflow_attempt a
  381 +           JOIN dbos.workflow_status s ON s.workflow_uuid = a.workflow_id
  382 +          WHERE a.run_id = $1 AND s.status = 'PENDING'
  383 +          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1`, runID).Scan(&wid); err !=
       nil {
  384 +        add("resolve-waiter", true, false, "no PENDING attempt for run "+
       runID)
  385 +        return finish(rep)
  386 +    }
  387 +    var dec string
  388 +    err = pool.QueryRow(ctx,
  389 +        `SELECT poc_approve($1, $2, $3, $4)`, runID, approver, decision,
       note).Scan(&dec)
  390 +    if err != nil {
  391 +        if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "already decided") {
  392 +            add("approve-record", false, true, "decision already stands;
       re-sending wake-up")
  393 +        } else {
  394 +            add("approve-record", true, false, err.Error())
  395 +            return finish(rep)
  396 +        }
  397 +    } else {
  398 +        rep.Data["decision"] = dec
  399 +        add("approve-record", true, true, "decision "+dec+" by "+approver
       )
  400 +    }
  401 +    if err := dbos.Send(cli, wid,
  402 +        dbosflow.ApprovalMsg{Decision: decision, Approver: approver, Note
       : note},
  403 +        dbosflow.ApprovalTopic(runID)); err != nil {
  404 +        add("approve-send", true, false, err.Error())
  405 +        return finish(rep)
  406 +    }
  407 +    rep.Data["waiting_workflow"] = wid
  408 +    add("approve-send", true, true, "woke "+wid)
  409 +    return finish(rep)
  410 +}

  +// RunOnceOp is RunOnce pinned to one op: when wantOp is non-empty only
  +// that row is claimable. The kill matrix pins its seeded row so a stale
  +// pending row from another run can neither steal the claim nor let a
  +// failpoint kill land on the wrong row (silent vacuity). Production
  +// drains keep oldest-first via RunOnce.
  +func RunOnceOp(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, app *ledger.Appender,
 wantOp string) error {
  +    // 1. Claim: one actionable row, attempts bumped, lock released on
  +    //    commit. A crash after commit but before append leaves the row
  +    //    actionable: re-driven, converging via the ledger precondition
  +    //    (pending) or verified re-check (appended/reconciling).
  +    var opID, employer, action, state string
  +    var payloadJSON []byte
  +    var payloadHash []byte
  +    var anchored *int64
  +    claimTx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
  +    if err != nil {
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: begin claim: %w", err)
  +    }
  +    defer claimTx.Rollback(ctx) // no-op after Commit; guards early returns
  +    claimSQL := `
  +        SELECT op_uuid, employer_id, action, payload, payload_hash, state, im
mu_tx
  +          FROM poc_outbox
  +         WHERE state IN ('pending', 'appended', 'reconciling')
  +         ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
  +         FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
  +    claimArgs := []any{}
  +    if wantOp != "" {
  +        claimSQL = `
  +            SELECT op_uuid, employer_id, action, payload, payload_hash, state
, immu_tx
  +              FROM poc_outbox
  +             WHERE state IN ('pending', 'appended', 'reconciling')
  +               AND op_uuid = $1::uuid
  +             FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
  +        claimArgs = append(claimArgs, wantOp)
  +    }
  +    row := claimTx.QueryRow(ctx, claimSQL, claimArgs...)
  +    if err := row.Scan(&opID, &employer, &action, &payloadJSON, &payloadHash,
 &state, &anchored); err != nil {
  +        if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
  +            return ErrNoWork
  +        }
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: claim: %w", err)
  +    }
  +    if _, err := claimTx.Exec(ctx,
  +        `UPDATE poc_outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now()
  +          WHERE op_uuid = $1`, opID); err != nil {
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: bump attempts: %w", err)
  +    }
  +    var attempts int
  +    if err := claimTx.QueryRow(ctx,
  +        `SELECT attempts FROM poc_outbox WHERE op_uuid = $1`, opID).Scan(&att
empts); err != nil {
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: read attempts: %w", err)
  +    }
  +    // Poison gate: ONLY rows with no proven append may go failed.
  +    // A proven append (immu_tx set) routes to the reconcile path
  +    // below no matter how high the counter stands (prompt8 §5.6;
  +    // the guard trigger fails closed if this ever regresses).
  +    if attempts > maxAttempts && anchored == nil {
  +        if _, err := claimTx.Exec(ctx,
  +            `UPDATE poc_outbox SET state = 'failed', updated_at = now()
  +              WHERE op_uuid = $1`, opID); err != nil {
  +            return fmt.Errorf("worker: mark failed: %w", err)
  +        }
  +        if err := claimTx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
  +            return fmt.Errorf("worker: commit poisoned: %w", err)
  +        }
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: op %s failed after %d attempts with no pro
ven append (marked failed)", opID, attempts)
  +    }
  +    if err := claimTx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: commit claim: %w", err)
  +    }
  +
  +    // 2. Build the expected record from the immutable payload.
  +    var p Payload
  +    if err := json.Unmarshal(payloadJSON, &p); err != nil {
  +        return fmt.Errorf("worker: bad payload for op %s: %w", opID, err)
  +    }
  +    rec := buildRecord(employer, action, payloadHash, p)
  +    idemKey := ledger.IdemKey(employer, action, opID)
  +    provKey := ledger.ProvKey(rec.EmployerID, rec.Artifact, rec.ArtifactID, r
ec.EventUUID)
  +
  +    var txID uint64
  +    curState := state
  +    if anchored == nil {
  +        // 3a. Append path (pending): B2 window, append (or verified
  +        // recover on precondition), B3 window, mark appended, B4
  +        // window, then the shared back-link tail.
  +        chaos.Trip("after-pg-commit-before-append") // B2 (EXPERIMENTS.md)
  +        txID, err = app.Append(ctx, rec, idemKey)
  +        if err != nil {
  +            if status.Code(err) == codes.FailedPrecondition ||
  +                status.Code(errors.Unwrap(err)) == codes.FailedPrecondition {
  +                txID, err = recoverTxVerified(ctx, app, idemKey, provKey, rec
)
  +                if err != nil {
  +                    return fmt.Errorf("worker: recover op %s: %w", opID, err)
  +                }
  +            } else {
  +                return fmt.Errorf("worker: append op %s: %w", opID, err)
  +            }
  +        }
  +
  +        chaos.Trip("after-append-before-backlink") // B3 (EXPERIMENTS.md)
  +
  +        appendTx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
  +        if err != nil {
  +            return fmt.Errorf("worker: begin appended: %w", err)
  +        }
  +        func() { _ = appendTx.Rollback(ctx) }()
  +        tag, err := appendTx.Exec(ctx, `
  +            UPDATE poc_outbox
  +               SET state = 'appended', immu_tx = $2, updated_at = now()
  +             WHERE op_uuid = $1 AND state = 'pending'`, opID, txID)
  +        if err != nil {
  +            return fmt.Errorf("worker: mark appended: %w", err)
  +        }
  +        if tag.RowsAffected() == 1 {
  +            if err := appendTx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
  +                return fmt.Errorf("worker: commit appended: %w", err)
  +            }
  +            curState = "appended"
  +        } else {
  +            // Restart path: another drive already marked it; verify
  +            // the anchored tx matches before proceeding.
  +            var st string
  +            var have uint64
  +            if err := appendTx.QueryRow(ctx,
  +                `SELECT state, immu_tx FROM poc_outbox WHERE op_uuid = $1`,
  +                opID).Scan(&st, &have); err != nil {
  +                return fmt.Errorf("worker: reread appended: %w", err)
  +            }
  +            if (st != "appended" && st != "reconciling") || have != txID {
  +                return fmt.Errorf("worker: op %s state %s tx %d diverges from
 append tx %d",
  +                    opID, st, have, txID)
  +            }
  +            curState = st
  +        }
  +
  +        chaos.Trip("after-appended-before-backlink") // B4 (reconcile battery
)
  +    } else {
  +        // 3b. Reconcile path (appended/reconciling): the append is
  +        // proven; re-verify the anchor (tx + marker + record bytes
  +        // at that tx) before touching the back-link. Never
  +        // re-appends, never poisons.
  +        txID = uint64(*anchored)
  +        if err := reconcileTxVerified(ctx, pool, app, opID, idemKey, provKey,
 rec, txID); err != nil {
  +            return fmt.Errorf("worker: reconcile op %s: %w", opID, err)
  +        }
  +    }
  +
  +    // 4. Back-link txn via the authorized recorder (squat-proof: the
  +    // outbox row must pre-exist with a matching tx; exact replays
  +    // converge). Duplicate convergence is ordinary success, not error.
  +    // A link FAILURE with a proven append moves appended ->
  +    // reconciling (stays actionable); it never discards.
  +    backTx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
  +    if err != nil {
  +        return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +            fmt.Errorf("worker: begin backlink: %w", err))
  +    }
  +    defer func() { _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx) }()
  +    var linked string
  +    if err := backTx.QueryRow(ctx,
  +        `SELECT poc_backlink_record($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,
  +        p.PGTable, p.PGID, p.EventUUID, txID, []byte(rec.Digest())).Scan(&lin
ked); err != nil {
  +        _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx)
  +        return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +            fmt.Errorf("worker: backlink record: %w", err))
  +    }
  +    if linked != "linked" && linked != "replayed" {
  +        _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx)
  +        return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +            fmt.Errorf("worker: backlink record returned %q", linked))
  +    }
  +    // NOTE: alh stores the content digest (re-verification anchor is the tx
  +    // id via VerifiedTxByID, not this column). See ADR-0204.
  +    tag, err := backTx.Exec(ctx, `
  +        UPDATE poc_outbox
  +           SET state = CASE WHEN state = 'reconciling' THEN 'reconciled' ELSE
 'backlinked' END,
  +               updated_at = now()
  +         WHERE op_uuid = $1 AND state IN ('appended', 'reconciling')`, opID)
  +    if err != nil {
  +        _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx)
  +        return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +            fmt.Errorf("worker: outbox transition: %w", err))
  +    }
  +    if tag.RowsAffected() != 1 {
  +        var st string
  +        if err := backTx.QueryRow(ctx,
  +            `SELECT state FROM poc_outbox WHERE op_uuid = $1`, opID).Scan(&st
); err != nil {
  +            _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx)
  +            return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +                fmt.Errorf("worker: reread terminal: %w", err))
  +        }
  +        if st != "backlinked" && st != "reconciled" {
  +            _ = backTx.Rollback(ctx)
  +            return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +                fmt.Errorf("worker: op %s in unexpected state %s", opID, st))
  +        }
  +        // Concurrent duplicate already converged: ordinary success.
  +    }
  +    if err := backTx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
  +        return markReconciling(ctx, pool, opID, curState,
  +            fmt.Errorf("worker: commit backlink: %w", err))
  +    }
  +    return nil
  +}

    1 +// Content verification (prompt8 §5.2): the auditor reads PostgreSQL
    2 +// through a read-only role, rebuilds the expected evidence from
    3 +// authoritative sources, re-executes the payroll from persisted
    4 +// inputs, and compares everything against cryptographically verified
    5 +// ledger bytes. It never trusts a supplied backlinks file (there is
    6 +// no such input): every binding is re-derived.
    7 +//
    8 +// Verification equation per evidence event:
    9 +//   A. stored output_digest == ledger OutputDigest (output binding)
   10 +//   B. stored tip content_hash == ledger InputDigest (input binding)
   11 +//   C. re-executed lines == persisted payroll_line rows, field by
   12 +//      field (inputs genuinely produce the persisted outputs; detects
   13 +//      input AND output tamper)
   14 +//   D. canon digest over PERSISTED rows == ledger OutputDigest
   15 +//      (pure PG-side recompute; detects output tamper alone)
   16 +//   E. snapshot pins == ledger RuleVersions/PackDigest
   17 +//   F. sha256(stored calc_version) == ledger CalcDigest
   18 +//   G. stored approval == ledger DecidedBy/DecidedAt
   19 +//   H. recomputed supersedes predecessor == ledger Supersedes
   20 +//   I. sha256(stored payload bytes) == ledger SHA256
   21 +//   J. identity: ledger event/artifact/table/id/employer == the
   22 +//      PG-claimed binding; marker verified with origin == backlink
   23 +//      tx; record origin == backlink tx; received bytes ==
   24 +//      reconstructed bytes
   25 +//   K. run status is validated (drafts are refused, never attested)
   26 +//   L. every backlink for the run verifies; every terminal outbox
   27 +//      row has its backlink (no missing links)
